text:
Maria: Heads-up: LumenX reporting flakey auth during staging onboarding. First request after app start returns 200 then several 401s in a row. Attaching their minimal repro and logs.

LumenX-Engineer: Repro steps: start app, hit /v1/generate repeatedly. Sometimes it returns 200 then 401. We rotate keys, same behaviour. No proxy aside from Cloudflare.

Tom: Can you share the SDK version and whether you use ephemeral tokens or long-lived keys? Also paste one raw Authorization header from a failing call.

LumenX-Engineer: Using lite-web SDK v0.9.2, ephemeral tokens via our auth service. Example header from fail: Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGci...xyz exp=171...

Ashley: Quick triage checklist: 1) ephemeral TTL vs clock skew 2) gateway introspection cache TTL 3) LB/instance sticky session 4) SDK handshake reuse quirk in 0.9.2.

Maria: They ran a debug loop (SDK debug enabled): ok, ok, fail, fail, ok, ok — repeating in ~10s blocks.

Sam: That pattern suggests an introspection or cache bouncing window or per-node handshake state. If one node validates token and another node hasn't warmed KV, subsequent requests fail.

Tom: @infra-bot any recent changes to staging auth cache TTL or gateway token cache behavior?

infra-bot: staging-auth-cache TTL = 30s. No config changes in last 7 days. Last related deployment: service/auth 1.12.3 on 2026-03-20.

Ashley: Also check client behavior: older SDKs reused a per-process handshake bound to a node-local secret. If the client reconnects to a different gateway instance, validation might fail until handshake completed. We fixed this in 0.9.3.

Maria: They are indeed on 0.9.2. I'll ask them to either upgrade to 0.9.3 or set REDWOOD_TOKEN_TTL=120 in staging as a temporary mitigation.

LumenX-Engineer: We'll upgrade to 0.9.3 and run the loop.

Tom: Meanwhile I'll pull auth-introspection logs and look for mismatch patterns or revokes. ETA 4h.

Ashley: I'll prepare a short support playbook for CS to apply TTL bump or a per-tenant stateless bypass in staging if needed. ETA 1h.

Maria: Upgrade result: after moving to 0.9.3 the intermittent 401s stopped—loop returned all ok. They will keep the change in staging for 24h and then request prod cutover.

Sam: Good. Capture SDK debug logs and add to CS ticket for the postmortem and make a note in onboarding docs to recommend v0.9.3+ for ephemeral token flows.

Maria: Logs uploaded to CS-9812. Closing after prod sign-off. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
